title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions would change if we used a different training dataset. Adding a new feature can increase the complexity of the model, which might affect variance.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: When you add a new feature, especially a polynomial feature like the square of an existing feature, it can increase the model's flexibility. This often leads to an increase in variance.

title: Analyzing the Effect
text: Consider how adding a squared feature affects the model's ability to fit different datasets. Does it make the model more sensitive to changes in the data?
